name: Soured pork with corn flour
nameVi: Thịt lợn ủ chua với bột ngô
summary: Thịt lợn ủ chua với bột ngô is pork soured with corn flour, from the limestone villages of the northern route.
howToEat: Ask for it at a village meal on the northern route.
